io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.long_description: Public settlement verify-wire for Node 34539544. Re-check a published claim's grounding against its source, get an admit or refuse disposition with the named failed limb, read settlement entity dossiers, and archive an append-only chain commitment you can re-fetch later to confirm the history was not rewritten. No signup, no keys, no charging.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.declared_versus_actual: The registry stores what a publisher declares and does not re-check it at runtime. This block is the declaration; /api/mcp initialize + tools/list is the actual. They are meant to be compared, including by third parties.
